name: San Francisco by Night Locations & Factions (Lore)

pages.name: The Cathayan Free Zone and the Wall

text.content:
Following the Kuei-jin conquest, the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} and the New Promise Mandarinate divided San Francisco into the Cathayan Free Zone (CFZ) and the Munificent Transitioning Sectors, an uneasy détente enforced by the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere}-built Ward Versus Cathayans laid across every bridge and the BART Tunnel out of the city. Any Kuei-jin attempting to cross unprotected suffers three dice of lethal damage at each of thirteen warded points per route (up to 39 dice total) and must resist fleeing back the way they came after each ward, unless carrying a Writ of Protected Passage. The wards were Luna Demian's creation, and only she and her protégé Martin Franckel can currently cast the ritual outside the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere}'s Las Vegas Chantry.

The wards also feed into San Francisco's broader mystical isolation: the city's "Wall" against the spirit worlds has grown stronger since the Traditions' setbacks and the Fae's ongoing war, cutting the city off from other supernatural factions' interference even as it becomes bleaker and more isolated.

Chinatown is the beating heart of Cathayan influence in San Francisco, home to the Tongs — Chinese criminal societies that predate the Kuei-jin invasion and now serve, wittingly or not, as intelligence networks and muscle for the Mandarinate. Chinatown's spies watch every street for @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} incursion, and the district's traditional culture is actively preserved by figures like Father Li T'ien, whose decades of community work have kept the Tongs from fully overrunning the neighborhood, until a recent uptick in drug trafficking reversed that trend.

Beyond Chinatown, several districts carry particular significance to the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}/Quincunx conflict. The Financial District and the area around the Trans-America Building suffer from especially inauspicious Chi, along with the Tenderloin and Bayview, making them dangerous ground for Kindred and Kuei-jin alike. Golden Gate Park, Lincoln Park, the Presidio, and the Golden Gate National Recreation Area were reclaimed from Kuei-jin control by the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.zCWdD1NpOCn03CwE]{Gangrel} duo Mirko Mirkonen and Gustavo Morales, who continue to hunt lone Cathayans there. The Richmond district was likewise wrested from Kuei-jin dominance by the same pair. The Japan Center anchors the city's separate Japanese Kuei-jin faction, the Green Courts.

pages.name: The Wicked City and the Yomi World

text.content: Beneath San Francisco's nights lies an incursion of the Yomi World — the Wicked City, a manifestation of Yama King Mikaboshi's hellish dominion accessible through vanishing buildings and impossible streets that should not exist. Its presence is proof of akuma activity in San Francisco, centered on Chan Te's Hollow City wu, and its discovery would spark investigation or inquisition among the Kuei-jin were it ever confirmed. Storytellers can use the Wicked City as a gateway for crossover stories involving Infernalism, the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}'s interest in demonic power, and the deeper mysteries of the Yama Kings.

pages.name: Factions at War: Camarilla, Mandarinate, Sabbat, and Anarchs

text.content:
San Francisco is caught between the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} (led by Prince Sara Anne Winder, with former Prince Jochen Van Nuys as liaison to the Mandarinate) and the New Promise Mandarinate, itself split between Jiejie Li's reformist Harmonious Menders of Broken Fences and the conservative Foreigner-Vanquishing Crusaders backed by outside Cloud Mandarins like Maximum Sun. Both major powers maintain a fragile, mutually convenient peace neither fully trusts.

The @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}, hoping to exploit the chaos, dispatched the Templar Consuela Martinez and her pack Killing Spree to sabotage @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}-Mandarinate diplomacy, though she increasingly relies on Carlos Griffouliere's contacts and Scarlet Carson O'Toole's pack, The Misery Lords, to make progress. San Francisco's anarchs, by contrast, keep an extremely low and transitory profile, using the Bay Area as a waypoint rather than a permanent territory, wary of alienating potential Camarilla allies against the Cathayan threat.
